completion_data.completion_summary: Wired reconcile-task-status.sh to three callers (/task --sync live sweep, /orchestrate entry once-per-invocation, skill-todo dry-run-then-confirm), added a handoff-aware promotion guard so automatic reconciliation cannot mask a blocked/partial outcome as success, and implemented the optional report-only plan-vs-state.json divergence check. Also fixed a pre-existing find_latest_artifact() crash on empty artifact directories discovered during fixture testing.

memory_candidates.content: In this codebase's bash scripts run under `set -euo pipefail`, `ls -1 "$dir"/*.md 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1` crashes the whole script (via pipefail) whenever $dir exists but is empty -- the unexpanded glob makes ls exit non-zero even though sort/tail succeed on empty input. Fix: append `|| true` to the pipeline when an empty result is a legitimate no-match case, not an error.

When wiring a caller to a script whose live mode is silent on no-op (only prints under --dry-run), bracket every live call: capture combined output, echo it verbatim when non-empty, and print an explicit no-op notice when empty. This is the pattern used across /task --sync, /orchestrate entry, and skill-todo in this codebase's reconcile-task-status.sh wiring -- a silent successful no-op is indistinguishable from 'never ran' without it.
